$comment: Curated model-card / system-card links, the reviewed source of truth for scripts/sync-model-cards.mts. RULES: (1) a card is a cited fact — every entry needs a real, reachable URL published by the model's own vendor, plus `source` and `asOf`; never guess a URL from a slug pattern, because a 404 is worse than no link at all; (2) `modelId` is the canonical model id the rest of the app keys on (a `model-catalog.ts` tracked id or a `scripts/data/intellect-scores.json` modelId) — alias forms (`anthropic/claude-opus-4-8`, `openrouter:...`, ACP labels) are NOT repeated here, because getModelCard() resolves them through the intellect alias table; (3) `kind` is `system-card` or `model-card` for a card about this specific model, and `index` for a vendor hub that lists cards — an `index` entry is a placeholder that discovery upgrades to the exact card as soon as it can reach the vendor's site, so prefer leaving a model in `wanted` over inventing a per-model URL; (4) Hugging Face-hosted weights need no entry at all — the README *is* the model card, and getModelCard() derives https://huggingface.co/<org>/<model> for `huggingface:` router ids, whose org/model casing comes from the HF API itself; (5) `wanted` lists models we want a card for but have not sourced one for yet — `npm run sync:model-cards -- --discover` matches vendor sitemaps and card hubs against `match` tokens and writes the winners into `cards`. Absent means 'no sourced card yet', and the UI simply shows no link.

cards.title: Anthropic transparency hub
cards.source: Anthropic's transparency hub is the published index of Claude system cards; the per-model PDF lives behind it on a CDN path with an opaque filename, so discovery has to resolve it.
